newsitem.title: GERMANY: German total tax revenues seen 20 bln DM short.
newsitem.headline: German total tax revenues seen 20 bln DM short.

text.p: German tax revenues will be just under 20 billion marks less than expected in 1997, government coalition sources said on Wednesday.

The news was leaked as federal, state and central bank officials were meeting with private-sector advisers in the eastern German town of Schwerin to examine the tax revenues. They were to deliver the new tax estimate on Thursday.
"It will be just under 20 billion marks," a coalition source told Reuters.
The federal budget foresees a deficit of 53.4 billion marks for 1997, in line with the European economic and monetary union goal.
